sn44.9:1.1: Atha kho Vacchagotto paribbājako yena Bhagavā tenupasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodi ||
sn44.9:1.2: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekam antaṃ nisīdi || || 3 Ekam antaṃ nisinno kho Vacchagotto paribbājako Bhagavantam etad avoca || ||
sn44.9:2.1: Purimāni bho Gotama divasāni purimatarāni sambahulānaṃ nānātitthiyānaṃ samaṇabrāhmaṇāparibbājakānam Kutūhalasālāyam sannisinnānaṃ sannipatitānam ayam antarā kathā udapādi || || 4
sn44.9:2.2: Ayaṃ kho Pūraṇo Kassapo saṅghī ceva gaṇī ca gaṇācariyo ca ñāto yasassī titthakaro sādhu sammato bahujanassa ||
sn44.9:2.3: so pi sāvakam abbhatītaṃ kālaṅkatam upapattīsu vyākaroti
sn44.9:2.4: Asu amutra upapanno asu amutra upapannoti || ||
sn44.9:2.5: Yo pissa sāvako uttamapuriso paramapuriso paramapattipatto tam pi sāvakam abbhatītaṃ kālaṅkatam upapattīsu vyākaroti ||
sn44.9:2.6: Asu amutra upapanno asu amutra upapannoti || || 5
sn44.9:3.1: Ayam pi kho Makkhali Gosālo || pe || 6
sn44.9:3.2: Ayam pi kho Nigaṇṭho Nāṭaputto || pe || || 7
sn44.9:3.3: Ayam pi kho Sañjayo Belaṭṭhiputto || pe || || 8
sn44.9:3.4: Ayam pi kho Pakuddho Kaccāyano || pe || || 9
sn44.9:3.5: Ayam pi kho Ajito Kesakambalo saṅghī ceva gaṇī ca gaṇācariyo ca ñāto yasassī titthakaro sādhu sammato bahujanassa ||
sn44.9:3.6: so pi sāvakam abbhatītam kālaṅkatam upapattīsu vyākaroti ||
sn44.9:3.7: Asu amutra upapanno asu amutra upapanno ti || ||
sn44.9:3.8: Yo pissa sāvako uttamapuriso paramapuriso paramapattiputto tam pi sāvakam abbhatītaṃ kālaṅkataṃ upapattīsu vyākaroti ||
sn44.9:3.9: Asu amutra upapanno asu amutra upapanno ti || || 10
sn44.9:4.1: Ayam pi kho samaṇo Gotamo saṅghī ceva gaṇi ca gaṇācariyo ca ñāto yasassī titthakaro sādhu sammato bahujanassa ||
sn44.9:4.2: so pi sāvakam abbhatītaṃ kālaṅkatam upapattīsu vyākaroti ||
sn44.9:4.3: Asu amutra upapanno asu amutra upapannoti || ||
sn44.9:4.4: Yo ca khvassa sāvako uttamapuriso paramapuriso paramapattipatto tam pi sāvakam abbhatītam kālaṅkatam upapattīsu na vyākaroti ||
sn44.9:4.5: Asu amutra upapanno asu amutra upapanno ti ||
sn44.9:4.6: api ca kho nam evaṃ vyākaroti
sn44.9:4.7: Acchejji taṇhaṃ vivattayi saññojanaṃ sammāmānābhisamayā antam akāsi dukkhassāti || || 11
sn44.9:4.8: Tassa mayham bho Gotama ahud eva kaṅkhā ahu vicikicchā
sn44.9:5.1: Alañhi te Vaccha kaṅkhituṃ alaṃ vicikicchituṃ ||
sn44.9:5.2: kaṅkhaniye ca pana te ṭhāne vicikicchā uppannā || ||
sn44.9:5.3: Saupādānassa khvāham Vaccha upapattim paññāpemi no anupādānassa || || 13
sn44.9:5.4: Seyyathāpi Vaccha aggi sa-upādāno jalati no anupādāno ||
sn44.9:5.5: evam eva khvāham Vaccha sa-upādānassa upapattim paññāpemi no anupādānassā ti || || 14
sn44.9:6.1: Yasmim pana bho Gotama samaye acci vātena khittā dūram pi gacchati || imassa pana bhavaṃ Gotamo kim upādānasmim paññāpetī ti || ||
sn44.9:6.2: Yasmiṃ kho Vaccha samaye acci vātena khittā dūram pi gacchati || tam ahaṃ vātupādānam vadāmi
sn44.9:6.3: vāto hissa Vaccha tasmiṃ samaye upādānaṃ hotī ti || || 15
sn44.9:6.4: Yasmiñ ca pana bho Gotama samaye imañ ca kāyam nikkhipati satto ca aññataraṃ kāyam anuppanno hoti || imassa pana bhavaṃ Gotamo kim upādānasmim paññāpetī ti || ||
sn44.9:6.5: Yasmiṃ kho Vaccha samaye imañ ca kāyam nikkhipati satto ca aññataram kāyam anuppanno hoti || tam ahaṃ taṇhupādānaṃ vadāmi ||
sn44.9:6.6: taṇhā hissa Vaccha tasmiṃ samaye upādānaṃ hotī
